title: Useful but Unwieldy: How Software Engineers Perceive the Design of Chain-of-Thought Explanations in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.30894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents (CAs) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software engineering (SE) workflows. As these CAs take up more tasks and responsibilities, it is imperative for software engineers to understand the CA's rationale behind its' decisions, also known as the chain-of-thought (CoT). During the interaction, some CAs are capable of showing this CoT as a separate message to users with the goal of providing transparency and explainability. However, its effectiveness as an explainable AI (XAI) mechanism for end-users in software engineering has not yet been established in the literature. This motivates us to understand their experiences with the CoT message as an XAI tool through a survey and semi-structured follow-up interviews with 36 software engineers. Through thematic analysis of the survey responses and interview transcripts, we found that CoT message is an indispensable tool for software engineers

translated_title: 有用但笨拙：软件工程师如何看待编码代理中思维链解释的设计
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的编码代理（CAs）正日益融入软件工程（SE）工作流程中。随着这些编码代理承担越来越多的任务和职责，软件工程师必须理解编码代理决策背后的推理逻辑，即思维链。在交互过程中，一些编码代理能够以单独消息的形式向用户展示这一思维链，旨在提供透明性和可解释性。然而，作为面向软件工程最终用户的可解释人工智能（XAI）机制，其有效性尚未在文献中得到证实。这促使我们通过对36名软件工程师开展调查和半结构化后续访谈，来了解他们将思维链消息作为XAI工具的使用体验。通过对调查回复和访谈记录的主题分析，我们发现思维链消息是软件工程师不可或缺的工具。
tldr: 本研究通过对36名软件工程师的调查与访谈发现，编码代理展示的思维链消息是软件工程师不可或缺的可解释性工具，但其设计仍显得笨拙、不易使用。
en_tdlr: Through a survey and interviews with 36 software engineers, this study finds that chain-of-thought messages in coding agents are an indispensable explainability tool, yet their design remains unwieldy.
